title: Lead — rasa.module.crm (records-family/1)
description: A sales opportunity against an account: one file under crm/leads/<stage>/, titled by its H1. The stage is the directory the file sits in; there is no stage key. Won and lost are terminal stages, never deleted.

id.description: Minted by `crm lead new`; never reused.

updated.description: Bumped by every tool edit; `crm touch` after a hand edit.

account.description: The account the opportunity is against. Required: an opportunity belongs to a customer.

contact.description: The person the deal is worked with.

source.description: Where the lead came from. Declare to constrain: config `sources`.

owner.description: Who is accountable for moving it.

value.description: The estimated deal value — sizes the funnel; not booked revenue. Always with `currency` (C-14).

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for `value`; only with a value (C-14).

next_action.description: The single next thing that moves the lead.

next_action_due.description: When the next action is due; only with a next_action.

closed.description: Stamped by `crm lead win` / `crm lead lose`; present exactly in the won and lost stages (C-04).

lost_reason.description: Why it was lost; present exactly in the lost stage (C-05).

qualified_on.description: Stamped when the lead cleared the declared qualification criteria (C-06).
